answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable genesis fee to earn, a sunk cost on identity creation. The fee starts at 40 credits and decays with honest work. One honest agent reaches the summit cheaply, while a forger faces a canyon: 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits against ~200 of reward, a guaranteed loss. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted; at the zenith of the fee curve, mass forgery loses money by design.
